plan.title: Reject proposal with missing recommended supplier

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before interacting with the prepared event.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B as specified.
Confirm the full line is allocated to one of the two bidding vendors before creating the proposal.
Open the proposal form after allocating the award.

args.goal: On the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1, leave that field empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop with the required-field refusal visible.

steps.note: Complete the proposal while deliberately omitting Recommended Supplier 1, then submit to trigger its validation.
Verify the omitted field is highlighted and the refusal identifies it as required.
